releases.title: 1.5.0: Share your library, faces made easier, photos on the map, updates from the app
releases.summary: Share your library or one person, label faces faster, see photos on the map where they were taken, and update the Windows app from the app. Everyone should update; multi-user instances and public links right away, for security fixes.

highlights.title: Share your library, a person or an album
highlights.body: Share your whole library or one person with another user, and let them add their photos to your albums. You decide what they see.

highlights.title: Faces, made easier
highlights.body: Draw a rough box and the face is found in it. Similar faces sit together, and one label covers the whole burst.

highlights.title: Photos on the map
highlights.body: The Places map shows every photo where it was taken, and Add place names your own spots, like Home.

highlights.title: 360° photos, originals and oldest first
highlights.body: Photo spheres open in a 360° view, zooming in loads the original, and your lists can run oldest first.

highlights.title: Updates from the app
highlights.body: Admins see when a new release is out. The Windows app downloads it and restarts into it.

highlights.title: Any GPU, one image
highlights.body: The regular Docker image runs faces, search and tags on Intel, AMD and NVIDIA GPUs. The separate GPU image is gone.

after_update.title: Recommended: rescan once
after_update.body: Account menu > Library, arrow next to Scan > Rescan. Finds photo spheres, time zones and copyright in photos you already had.

after_update.title: Windows app: click Scan once
after_update.body: 1.3.0 and 1.4.0 on Windows left new photos without date, place and camera. Account menu > Library > Scan reads them again.

after_update.title: Public links show only what you allow
after_update.body: Public pages now follow your Public Sharing Defaults everywhere. Check them under Settings if visitors should see dates or places.

releases.title: 1.4.0: Edits written to your files, editing many photos at once, search filters
releases.summary: Your edits now reach your files, you can fix the date and place of many photos at once, and search has filters. Every instance should update; multi-user instances right away, for a security fix.

highlights.title: Your edits, in your files
highlights.body: With Write edits to files on, tags, captions, locations and rotations now go into your files too. Write now writes the edits you made before.

highlights.title: Fix many photos at once
highlights.body: Select photos and choose Change date and time or Set location to fix them all together.

highlights.title: Filter your search
highlights.body: The Filters button on the search results narrows them by people, camera, date, place, rating and file type.

highlights.title: Collections and Archive
highlights.body: Group albums into collections, and archive photos to take them off the timeline while they stay in your albums.

highlights.title: Finish the upgrade card
highlights.body: The work an update leaves now runs from a card in the Admin Area, with its progress, instead of commands in a terminal.

releases.title: 1.3.0: Timeline filter, videos that play everywhere, faster search
releases.summary: Filter the timeline, play every video in your browser, and search faster. Every instance should update; multi-user instances right away, for security fixes.

highlights.title: Filter the timeline
highlights.body: Use the Filter button on the timeline to hide screenshots and documents, or show only videos or favorites. Save as default keeps your choice.

highlights.title: Videos play in every browser
highlights.body: Videos that did not play in your browser before now play, for example iPhone videos in Firefox.

highlights.title: Fix a wrong category
highlights.body: If a photo is marked as a screenshot or document by mistake, fix it with the badge in the photo details.

highlights.title: Faster search and scans
highlights.body: Search, scans and the app are faster and need less memory.

highlights.title: Remove photo details from old thumbnails
highlights.body: Thumbnails made before 1.3.0 still contain the location and camera details of the photo, and public links show them. One cleanup removes that data.

releases.title: 1.2.1: SQLite databases repaired
releases.summary: Repairs SQLite databases, which the unified Docker image and the standalone Windows build use. PostgreSQL installs are not affected.

releases.title: 1.2.0: A Windows app, Memories, and faster scans
releases.summary: A standalone Windows build that needs no Docker, every machine learning model on ONNX Runtime, Memories, faster scans and a faster web app, and a long list of security fixes.
